section: 3. Dice Check and Prelude to Landriel's Breakdown
description: Character ability dice check, mind control and Love-obsessed trait values appear, Landriel begins to show abnormalities, Dolores's extraordinary identity faintly reveals itself

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I fucking don't want to go down there to find them!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Come on, little player5! And little player4! We'll be an adventure party forever even in the sky! This time, remember to keep an eye on little player8, don't let her mess with everyone's memories again! And everyone, remember to write diaries every day—"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Landriel, already shattered into a puddle on the ground, Dolores kneeling beside her laughing maniacally, Peropha covering her mouth with her hand, Hidariva looking utterly bewildered. Goodbye, goodbye. I too once enjoyed adventuring with you all. But what was all this built upon? Could they truly accept such evil just like that? Are they even still human?

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 lies on the ground, with her last breath, "Wuwu, I really want to take a look at player2's diary... No, wait, what if player2's diary was also written under my influence... In this world, what is actually real..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "My diary? Uh, how about I recite it from memory for you now while little player5 is still sharpening his sword... Wait, you seem to be dead already, then I'll have to wait until I go down there to recite it for you!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: So player5 walked towards Dolores with his sword. She turned her head, her eyes already devoid of light. "I... Did I love everyone..." Her final murmur dissipated into the air. Her blood mingled with Landriel's, forming a dark puddle. So the Evil God's blood is also red, player5 thought. Then he noticed Landriel didn't seem to be dead yet, so he thrust his sword into her body.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 saw Hidariva trying to escape. Sigh... Only now feeling afraid... He used Misty Step to flash in front of Hidariva. Hidariva looked terrified. She pleaded, "Don't kill me, I haven't done anything bad, I just wanted to have fun adventures! Why did it turn out like this?" player5 said, "Yeah... Why did you recruit us into your party, Hidariva? You're the one who ruined me..." Seeing no escape, Hidariva drew her weapon to resist. Unfortunately, she couldn't withstand the gleaming blade. Hidariva fell, warm blood splashing onto player5's face.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: [image]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 looked at his companions' corpses and couldn't help but sigh. When he first joined the party, he had marveled at Landriel's superb magic, loved Dolores and Peropha's gentleness, and envied Hidariva's boundless energy. Those beautiful fantasies about an adventuring life... now seemed utterly ironic. Why did I let myself sink into such a quagmire? Why did all this happen before my eyes, yet I remained oblivious... Do I even deserve to represent justice? Perhaps someone like me only deserves the same end as them...

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: So player5 looked at the sky and the sun one last time, then closed his eyes. He plunged the sword into his own heart. The taste of blood rose in his throat, and everything before him turned dark. Thus, there was no more evil, no more justice, no adventuring party, no everyone. The sky was azure, the sunlight bright. Apart from the corpses on the grass, everything seemed just like before.
